Commercial banks are quoting between twenty point three five and twenty point four two. I could not check your email this time: the Gmail connection has expired and needs to be re-authorized in your connector settings. Your calendar is clear. There are no events or appointments between now and the end of January. The Zambia leg earned one thousand one hundred and fourteen Kwacha in revenue, with two hundred and seventy four Kwacha in fees, for a profit of about eight hundred and forty one Kwacha.
